chunks: Al-Shaykh, may Allah have mercy on him, informed me from Abu al-Qasim Ja'far ibn Muhammad, from his father, from Sa'd ibn 'Abd Allah, from Hamzah ibn Ya'la, from Muhammad ibn Sinan, who said: Some of our companions narrated to me from Abi 'Abd Allah عليه السلام.
He عليه السلام said: There is no objection to performing wudu (ablution) with water that is placed in the sun.

key_terms.الَّذِي: which; referring to the water under discussion
key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ: there is no objection; an expression indicating permissibility

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to perform wudu with water that has been placed in the sun?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal ruling that there is no objection to using water placed in the sun for wudu (ablution). It addresses a jurisprudential question related to ritual purity and indicates the permissibility of such water for worship.
